description: Record Codex session identity for tmux workspace recovery.

hooks.command: p="$PWD"; wc=$(command -v worktree-claim 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$wc" ]; then exit 0; fi; out=$("$wc" verify-writer --path "$p" 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || [ "$rc" -eq 12 ]; then exit 0; elif [ "$rc" -eq 10 ] || [ "$rc" -eq 11 ] || [ "$rc" -eq 13 ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; else exit 0; fi
